data.description:
# Docs: cold-start immunity — config knobs, code comments, routing/README docs, post-change evidence

Parent: LP-0MV9UNIOZ009RIAN (Implement grace-period immunity: local cold-start 503s must not trigger a 60s local cooldown)

## Goal

Document the grace-period immunity behaviour everywhere it is surfaced — `cold_start.py` / `provider.py` code comments, `proxy/config.yaml` cold-start knobs, `proxy/README.md` and `proxy/docs/routing.md` cooldown sections — and capture the pre/post evidence that local cooldown episodes in the hour after a restart drop to ~0.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Logs/metrics evidence pre/post: local cooldown episodes in the hour after a restart drop to ~0.
- All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments in `cold_start.py`/`provider.py`, `proxy/config.yaml` knobs, and any relevant docs entries (e.g. `proxy/docs/`).
- `proxy/config.yaml` cold-start knob comments (~line 1038) note that a 503/connection-error deferral during the window means no 60s cooldown is applied; the knobs themselves are unchanged.
- `proxy/README.md` cooldown section (~line 597) and `proxy/docs/routing.md` (cooldown/fallback behaviour) document the local cold-start exemption, explicitly scoped to the warm-up window.
- No functional code changes in this feature (docs + evidence only).

## Minimal Implementation

- Edit `proxy/proxy/cold_start.py` module docstring; add a short immunity note (the cold window also serves as the immunity boundary; `is_cold()` is the single boundary signal).
- Edit the two `proxy/proxy/provider.py` function docstrings (changed by the implementation feature) to describe the deferral (local + cold + 503/conn-error → defer; other 5xx still quarantine).
- Edit `proxy/config.yaml` cold-start comment block; edit `proxy/README.md`; edit `proxy/docs/routing.md` cooldown paragraphs.
- Record the post-change evidence (log query, `cold_start_deferral` attempt counts, cooldown episodes) as a comment on the parent work item and/or this item, compared against the pre-change baseline (~12 of 45 episodes in the analysed 24h window).

## Key Files

- `proxy/proxy/cold_start.py`
- `proxy/proxy/provider.py`
- `proxy/config.yaml` (~line 1038 cold-start block; `provider_cooldown_seconds` ~line 581)
- `proxy/README.md` (~line 597 cooldown section)
- `proxy/docs/routing.md` (cooldown/fallback sections)

## Dependencies

- Depends on the implementation feature (documents the actual shipped behaviour).

## Deliverables

- Updated docs/comments as per the ACs.
- Post-change evidence entry.
